name: SearchVesa
author: metamateplungin

sections.description:
SearchVesa helps you optimise WordPress posts and pages for search engines without leaving the post editor — write your own SEO titles, meta descriptions, and URL slugs, preview exactly how they’ll look on Google and social media, catch images missing alt text, and check your on-page SEO with a built-in score dashboard. Every field is yours to edit by hand, for free, with no account, sign-up, or API key required.

What’s included, free

  • Fully editable SEO title, meta description, and focus keyword fields
  • Manual URL slug editor
  • Missing image alt-text detection (scan your content, edit alt text directly)
  • SERP (search result) preview, desktop and mobile
  • Facebook (Open Graph) and Twitter Card fields, with live social previews
  • Overall / Readability / SEO score dashboard with a detailed pass/warning/error checklist
  • No account, license key, or external sign-up of any kind

Want AI-generated suggestions?

MetaMate Premium is a separate, more powerful plugin sold directly on metamateplugin.com. It adds AI-generated titles, descriptions & URL slugs, AI content analysis with one-click auto-fix, AI internal linking suggestions, AI schema markup (JSON-LD) generation, AI content humanisation, background processing, LinkedIn previews, and priority support. This free plugin shows where those AI features would be (as a greyed-out button linking to the Premium page) but never calls any external AI service itself, and doesn’t require Premium for anything listed above.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the searchvesa folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” screen in WordPress.
  3. Open any post or page editor — the SearchVesa meta box appears below the content editor.
  4. Type your SEO title and meta description directly into the fields, set a focus keyword, and click “Analyze Content” to see your SEO & readability score.
sections.faq:
Do I need an account to use SearchVesa?

No. Every feature in this plugin works without any account, sign-up, license key, or external API call of any kind.

Does this plugin send any of my content to an external service?

No. This plugin makes no outbound API calls at all — everything runs locally in your browser and on your own server. (MetaMate Premium, a separate plugin, does call an AI service for its AI-generation features; see that plugin’s own documentation.)

Can I manually type my own SEO title and meta description?

Yes — every field is fully editable by hand, with no limits.

What are the greyed-out “AI Suggest” buttons?

They show where MetaMate Premium’s AI-generated title/description/slug suggestions would appear. Clicking one opens the MetaMate Premium page in a new tab; nothing is sent anywhere and no data leaves your site.

What data does SearchVesa store on my site?

Your focus keyword, SEO title, meta description, and Open Graph/Twitter Card fields are stored as post meta on the relevant post. Nothing is stored outside of your own WordPress database.

What happens if I upgrade to MetaMate Premium later?

MetaMate Premium reads the same post meta fields, so your existing titles, descriptions, and social settings carry over. Deactivate this free plugin before activating Premium — running both at once isn’t supported, and MetaMate Premium will show a notice if it detects this plugin is still active.
